subject.title: Complementary tool: automated skill quality scoring for curation workflow

question: Should ClawHub officially integrate or endorse this external evaluator, and if so must semantic scores and eval results remain advisory rather than affect moderation, ranking, or installability?
rationale: Current ClawHub contracts distinguish deterministic publish gates, supporting scanner evidence, and platform-owned security verdicts; adding external model judgments changes evaluator authority, data handling, provenance, and how users interpret trust signals.

options.title: Define advisory pilot
options.body: Create a bounded non-enforcement pilot with explicit provider consent, reproducible provenance, and no effect on moderation, ranking, or installability.

options.title: Document external tool only
options.body: Permit community use and linking without official execution or display in ClawHub trust surfaces.

options.title: Decline official integration
options.body: Keep curation signals limited to platform-owned deterministic and security workflows.

recommendation.title: Define advisory pilot
recommendation.body: Create a bounded non-enforcement pilot with explicit provider consent, reproducible provenance, and no effect on moderation, ranking, or installability.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS and recent current-main history place the affected publish, moderation, and scanner contracts in his area.
